title: 第246章 证道真仙果位方可才达成目标第245章 成功复活凡人妻
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 李长生呆呆地看着怀里宛如木偶一般僵硬的江翠萍。虽然他是老阴逼，大乘老怪，但是此刻依旧慌了神。。
李长生双眼瞬间变得猩红一片。
大乘期巅峰的神识探入了江翠萍的无垢仙躯之中。
神识扫过江翠萍的四肢百骸。
经脉宽阔如奔腾的江河。
骨骼晶莹剔透宛如世间最纯净的仙玉。
血液中甚至还流淌着一丝丝金色的真仙法则碎片。
李长生地在脑海中排除着一个又一个的可能。
他的神识小心翼翼地顺着江翠萍的经脉。
探入了江翠萍的识海之中。
李长生整个人僵硬在了原地。
江翠萍的识海中，竟然空空荡荡。
散发着金白色光芒的仙魂胚胎。
仙魂胚胎之中，只有纯粹的灵魂本源力量，却没有任何记忆波动。
江翠萍的记忆和感情通通消失不见了。
就像是一张被强行格式化了的白纸。
他的神识化作千丝万缕。
在江翠萍的识海中地搜寻着。
最后的结果依旧很残忍。
狂暴的大乘期灵力瞬间失去控制。
在密室之中地肆虐开来。
坚固无比的密室墙壁被刮出无数道深深的裂痕。
content_en:
Li Changsheng stared blankly at Jiang Cuiping, who was as stiff as a puppet in his arms. Although he is an old yin and a Mahayana monster, he is still panicking at this moment. .
"Why?"
"Why is this happening?"
Li Changsheng's eyes instantly turned scarlet.
The spiritual consciousness at the peak of the Mahayana period penetrated into Jiang Cuiping's innocent immortal body.
Divine consciousness swept across Jiang Cuiping's limbs and bones.
The immortal body is flawless.
The meridians are as wide as a rushing river.
The bones are crystal clear like the purest fairy jade in the world.
There are even traces of golden fragments of the True Immortal Law flowing in the blood.
Although the heartbeat is slow.
But powerful.
"The physical body is fine."
"There is no problem with the materials."
"So what's the problem?"
Li Changsheng was ruling out one possibility after another in his mind.
His consciousness carefully followed Jiang Cuiping's meridians.
All the way up.
Explored into Jiang Cuiping's sea of ​​consciousness.
The next second.
Li Changsheng froze in place.
His eyes were full of disbelief.
Jiang Cuiping's sea of ​​consciousness was actually empty.
Just a faint clump.
Immortal soul embryo exuding golden white light.
Suspended in the center of the sea of ​​consciousness.
In the Immortal Soul embryo, there is only the pure soul source power, but there is no memory fluctuation.
Jiang Cuiping's memories and emotions disappeared.
It's like a blank piece of paper that has been forcibly formatted.
There is nothing left.
Li Changsheng refused to give up.
His spiritual consciousness turned into thousands of threads.
Searching in Jiang Cuiping's sea of ​​consciousness.
Every corner.
Every inch of emptiness.
He didn't even let it go.
But...
The final result is still cruel.
"Ah."
Li Changsheng raised his head.
Let out a shrill roar.
The violent Mahayana spiritual power instantly lost control.
It raged in the secret room.
The extremely solid wall of the secret room was scratched with numerous deep cracks.
He fell down beside the jade bed.
